note: The permanent SPECIMIND catalog. One entry per published specimen; codes are never renumbered or reused. Filled from each episode's brief.json + facts.json + script.json by `node scripts/catalog_sync.mjs E###` (Playbook P, last step); the human then pastes links and affiliate_url. The Drawer component and the site (site/build.mjs) read this file, so it must only contain real specimens. The site build validates it and fails on a bad edit.

specimens[].episode: 'E001'. Used for the affiliate sub-ID p-{platform}-e001.
specimens[].hook_lines: The first caption, one string per line (the page fits each line edge to edge).
specimens[].flaw: Max 5 words ('Thin parts fuse'): the Weakness row.
specimens[].flaw_caption: The caption after 'Honest flaw:' ('the handle fused.').
specimens[].free_tier: Free-tier limit, from research.md, or 'Not published'.
specimens[].paid_from: Cheapest paid plan with currency and period, or 'Not published'.
specimens[].posted_on: YYYY-MM-DD the video posts (planned, then actual).
specimens[].updated_on: YYYY-MM-DD, set by catalog_sync on re-sync.
specimens[].conditions: [{key, value}] Collection conditions card (Input, Plan, Attempts, Retries, Edited ...).
specimens[].field_notes: [{key, value}] Field notes card; the 'Weakness' row is circled in red ink.
specimens[].homepage: https URL of the tool (the 'Try' button when there is no affiliate_url).
specimens[].cover: Repo path of the episode cover PNG; copied to /<code>/cover.png.
specimens[].links: {youtube, instagram, x}: post URLs, filled by the human after posting. A YouTube URL turns on the embedded Short.
specimens[].affiliate_url: Empty until the human pastes the tracking link. Requires disclosure 'Affiliate'. Gets rel='sponsored noopener'.
specimens[].affiliate_subid_param: Optional. Sub-ID query parameter for this link's network; auto-detected for impact.com (subId1), PartnerStack (sid), FirstPromoter (fp_sid), CJ (sid), ShareASale (afftrack), Awin (clickref), Rakuten (u1). '' = the network has no sub-IDs.
specimens[].corrections: [{date, text}] Dated errata, shown on the page. Never renumber; correct.

groups[].title: 'Tripo vs Meshy vs Hunyuan3D'.
groups[].members: [{code?, tool?, rank?, note?, verdict?}]: the specimens involved; code links to its page.
